profile_text.body:
Adobe is a public company founded in 1982 and headquartered in San Jose, CA, listed on public markets under the ticker ADBE. Its most recently reported annual revenue was $23,769,000,000, filed on a 10-K for the period ending 2025-11-28. The company's website centers on Adobe Express, which it describes as an all-in-one design, photo, and video tool for creating social content, videos, logos, and similar material, with an AI Assistant that the site says allows users to prompt, create, and edit content while preserving chosen elements.

Adobe tracks several AI products across multiple categories. Adobe Express AI is a lightweight design tool with integration of Adobe Firefly, and both Express AI and Firefly carry what Adobe describes as a commercial-safe training claim for image generation. Premiere Pro AI covers professional video editing with features the company calls generative extend and color match, also under a commercial-safe training claim. Adobe Podcast AI offers audio enhancement including speech enhancement and microphone check, again with a commercial-safe training claim attached.

The held facts note 174 legal exposure entries associated with California, though no specific cases are recorded in the data. Adobe has a CIK of 0000796343 with the SEC and is recorded as a for-profit public company. No MCP server presence is recorded for the company.
